Dear [Mr Humbert](/person/730),
I have just received a note from [Lady Susanna Blunt](/person/164) asking me the day and time of the opening of [St Cross](/organisation/130), and whether tickets will be necessary for admission to the services. Being unable to be present I had unfortunately destroyed the notice you were so good as to send me, and thus I cannot answer her questions. Would you therefore be kind enough to send one of the papers to her husband -
the [Revd Colvin Blunt](/person/2077)
Ryde View
Alverstoke
Gosport
And you will much oblige
Yours faithfully

C M Yonge
